pages.text: A pawn that reaches the far side of the board is promoted: it becomes a queen, rook, bishop or knight, whichever you choose. Most players choose a queen.
The pawn can't stay a pawn on the last rank, and it can't become a king. You may promote even if you still have your queen, so you can have two queens or more.
A pawn can promote by capturing too. Here the pawn on b7 is blocked, but it can take the rook on a8 and become a queen there.
Push a pawn that no enemy pawn can stop. Each step forward makes it more dangerous, and a new queen often wins the game.

puzzles.hint: A pawn is promoted when it reaches the last rank. How far is this one from it?

puzzles.prompt: Promote a pawn. One of them is blocked.
puzzles.hint: A pawn can't move forward onto a square where a piece stands.

puzzles.prompt: Promote your pawn. It can't move straight ahead.
puzzles.hint: A pawn captures diagonally forward, and that works on the last rank too.

puzzles.prompt: Checkmate in one move, by promoting.
puzzles.hint: The black king is stuck behind its own pawns. A new queen on the top rank would check it.
